results.releaseNotes: When precipitation is expected soon, you’ll see a new dedicated Precipitation Page that helps you understand when, how much, and what type of precipitation to expect. The 3 hour and 24 hour views make it easier to plan your day, from commuting to outdoor plans.
results.description:
Plan with confidence and stay safe with The Weather Network app, your trusted daily planner for accurate weather. 

Trusted by over 10 million users for reliable forecast, real-time weather radar, and instant storm alerts for over 35 years. 
Whether you need a local forecast for my location or travel weather for an international trip, you’ll have the most reliable local weather forecast at your fingertips, covering all of North America and beyond.

Features You’ll Love:
Accurate Local Forecasts – Get the most accurate weather forecast right in your neighbourhood. Plan everything with our Hourly Forecast, 7-day, and long-range 14-Day Forecast, with real-time updates every 15 minutes.

Live Radar Maps – Track storms precisely with our advanced Radar and Satellite maps. Our GPS accuracy shows weather at your exact location. Explore map layers for temperature, precipitation, wind, fire, clouds, and highway conditions.

Severe Weather Alerts  – Your Outdoor Safety comes first. Receive instant Custom Notifications for all types of Severe Weather. Get Severe Storm Alerts, Lightning Alerts, Snow & Rain Alerts, and Temperature Swing Alerts, including official government warnings for your location.

Precipitation Start & Stop Times – Never get caught in the rain or snow again! Our precipitation graphs show you exactly when rain or snow will start and stop, accurate to the minute.

Health & Weather Reports – Essential for outdoor planning, our detailed reports on Air Quality, UV Index, and allergy risks for your Nearby Weather conditions help you prepare for your day.

Weather News & Video – Go beyond the forecast with breaking news and analysis from our weather experts.

Customizable Weather Widget – Get a quick glance at today's forecast. Add our customizable widget to your home or lock screen for instant weather updates.

Siri Shortcuts – Get quick access to your most-used weather features.

Bilingual Weather (English / French) – Full support in both English and French.

Go Ad-Free – Your forecast, simplified.  A completely ad-free experience.. Subscribe today.

Get the most accurate local forecast right in your neighbourhood. Plan everything with our daily, hourly, 7 & 14-day forecasts. Never get caught in the rain or snow again! Our precipitation graphs show you the exact start and stop times, down to the minute.

Track storms precisely with our advanced live radar. Safety first: get real-time severe weather alerts and official government warnings to stay prepared.

Plan smart with  Air Quality, UV and Pollen reports. The most accurate forecast for every travel destination—from Toronto to Berlin.
Get a quick glance at today's forecast with our customizable widgets for your home screen & lock screen, so you're always ready to go.

Get Canada's weather app, the most accurate and reliable weather forecast for your exact location. Download The Weather Network app today. Your weather, when it really matters.
